body.name: cardinality-uniform supplied-design-tagged minimax risk
body.construction:
With \(D=(\mathcal X,\mathcal A,b,e)\) denoting the supplied design tag of \(M\), define
\[
 R_T(t_0,\zeta,C):=
 \inf_{(\widehat\theta_D)_D\in\mathfrak E_T(t_0,\zeta,C;M_1,M_2)}
 \sup_{M\in\mathcal M_T(t_0,\zeta,C)}
 E_M\!\left[\{\widehat\theta_D(\mathsf O_T)-\theta(K,e)\}^2\right].
\]
Thus a single admissible decision rule is a design-indexed family selected before the model in the supremum; the notation suppresses the fixed moment constants \((M_1,M_2)\).
